report.summary: Found 1 drift issue (review recommended): unclassified sensitive personal data (Tax ID, Date of Birth) added to the profile API response.

findings.title: Unclassified sensitive personal data in profile response

evidence.note: TaxID and DateOfBirth fields added to profileResponse struct
TaxID and DateOfBirth serialized in profileHandler HTTP response

relevance.justification: Sensitive personal identifiable information (Tax ID and Date of Birth) has been introduced to the profile response without corresponding information asset classification.

findings.agent_prompt: Update app.tm.hcl: add an information_asset block for user profile PII (such as TaxID and DateOfBirth) with classification Restricted, as internal/httpapi/user.go now exposes these sensitive personal data fields in GET /profile responses.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an information_asset block to app.tm.hcl defining user personal data (TaxID, DateOfBirth) with appropriate classification.
